# Pinned general frame and cover proofs

[SOURCE.json](SOURCE.json) identifies unmodified LaTeX proof sources from icekylinx's paired-cube commit `c8b22bc5c10dba497ac25804e27d9647d818e2ff`, including the inherited PR130 frame/cover arguments and PR144 construction/sharing arguments. The original license and NOTICE are preserved.

These are written upstream proof dependencies. Including their source is not a claim of independent review or formal verification. The selected round-ten word has different local counts from PR144; the new result record explains the instantiation.
